SHRM-CP & SCP Question of the Day: Under the ADA, when can an employer first require a medical exam?
A. Before the first interview
B. After a conditional job offer
C. Only after 90 days on the job
D. Never, for any job
Answer: B. After a conditional job offer. Before an offer, medical exams are off-limits. After a conditional offer, an employer may require one if everyone entering the same job category gets it.
